description: Ubiquitin (ANM/ANMT from systems/ubiquitin) next to a 12-bp DNA duplex (utils/generate-sa.py), held in contact by a mutual trap. Protein first in the topology.

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')

xfail.det: by design: the original code also gives the amino acid the nucleotide's excluded-volume torque (protein->torque -= protein->orientationT * -torquenuc), which does not conserve angular momentum or energy (see the nve check of this case: the original drifts); the current code applies only (r x F) about the amino-acid centre in the amino acid's frame (bbbe1c00), which is ~0 for this central force, so ANMT trajectories diverge at the first protein-nucleotide contact

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')
